_note: Public reviews of Tanit XR courses and programs, quoted word for word from the author's own public post. 'course' picks the page (splats = /splats-with-phones/), 'home' also puts it in the homepage testimonials. Ines saves them through the Tanit Inbox shortcut; the daily sweep adds them here.

items.name: Salma Ramadan
items.role: XR developer and technical artist, Splats With Phones participant
items.quote: 30 separate 3D scans. One house. 30 mins. It's amazing how far 3D gaussian splatting has come. I didn't have specialized LIDAR camera or professional scanning equipment. just my iphone 13 and a piece of heritage i wanted to document. Special thanks to Tanit XR and Mark Jeffcock who pushed me to go bigger with my scans.

items.name: Dee Dee Chainey-Jones
items.role: Storyteller and narrative strategist, Splats With Phones participant
items.quote: Huge thanks for an excellent deep dive into Gaussian splatting to Mark Jeffcock, Ines Said at Tanit XR, and Arrival.Space. It's been an amazing 6 weeks, and I've very much enjoyed scanning the local landscape and heritage and seeing the group's own offerings from around the world!
